Hi, I ordered the Thistlebeam desk lamp (order TB-20931) on September 14 and was charged twice on my card: two identical charges of 64.90 appeared on September 15. The lamp arrived yesterday and works perfectly, no complaints there. Could you refund the duplicate charge? I need it sorted before my card statement closes on Friday. No rush on anything else, and thanks for the lovely lamp.
